column8: Initially didn't realise that when inputting bets, it's additive, not the overall wager.  For example, if an initial player has bet $2, and then another player raises to $4, then the initial player should input $2 to call the $4, and not input $4.  Because $2 + another $2 = $4.
column9:
- hard to remember who was the dealer, small blind and big blind
- was annoying to have to input the blinds each time for each player, i wish these got paid automatically
- can't split pot when both players have the same winning hand
- no shortcut to go all in
- was especially annoying to have to manually input a call, when this should be an easy quick one touch action
